title: Local reports skip the CLI composition root
goal: susi review and susi os-clean read only the host's own files but ran the full CLI composition root, whose cloud-endpoint registration (model catalog walk plus credential scout) took 4.2 s. They now wire only the plane handlers. Measured (debug, isolated home, median of 3): review 4,845 -> 267 ms, os-clean 4,906 -> 277 ms, identical output. susi keys list likewise: 4,955 -> 328 ms on an isolated home and 5,461 -> 288 ms on the real home, output identical.
